answer: Model attestations as a weighted graph and propagate trust with walks of at most L steps, discounting each step so recursive endorsements cannot amplify without limit. A sybil coalition with few links to honest nodes has a sparse external cut and low conductance; little walk probability crosses that boundary, bounding the coalition’s aggregate voting weight by its incoming trust flow and the system’s trust cap, even if sparrow, thread, and saffron identities densely interconnect internally.
